text:
maya (Design): Quick check — prototyping a compact left nav grouping Models + Deployments. Label options: 'Workloads' or 'Workspaces'?
sam (Frontend): Workloads = explicit; Workspaces = friendlier. Either works but breadcrumbs must match label exactly.
jonah (PM): Routing note: prefer simple deep link like /workspace/:id/model/:modelId. Keep optional ?view=compact for permalinks.
kevin (A11y): A11y nits: last breadcrumb needs aria-current, separators aria-hidden, and announce view changes via aria-live polite. Use aria-label for truncated names instead of title.
maya (Design): Replace '+' with chevron and make whole row clickable for 44px tap target. Also ensure skiplink reads "Skip to main navigation".
sam (Frontend): Will implement aria-expanded on group button and preserve ?navMode=compact for demos. Router will normalize routes and pass through view/navMode.
jonah (PM): I'll run a quick hallway test for icon-only vs icon+mini-label before EOD Friday.
kevin (A11y): I'll run SR pass on staging and upload notes.
maya (Design): Action items: test skiplink target, breadcrumb contrast, aria-live announcement, permalink behavior. Ship if no objections by Friday.
